CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  March 17, 2025

 The audio and video recordings of the meeting are available here: PC Meeting – March 17,
  2025 (Audio).m4a / PC Meeting – March 17, 2025 (Video).mp4

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Fisher, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Pham, Garcia, Olson

  Commissioner Grijalva participated via video conference and disclosed
  that there was no one else in the room over the age of 18 with her.

  Absent:  Mojarro

  Commissioner Dorado arrived at 7:05 P.M.

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Maia McCurley, Principal Planner;
  Jessica Vargas, Associate Planner; Karabeth Garcia, Executive
  Assistant; Erica Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – FEBRUARY 3, 2025 (7:01 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the February 3, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the February 3, 2025, Regular Meeting
  of the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  MINUTES – AUGUST 1, 2022 (7:01 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the August 1, 2022, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the August 1, 2022, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  MINUTES – JULY 18, 2022 (7:01 P.M.)

  1
  03/17/2025
   •  Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the July 18, 2022, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.
  •  Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the July 18, 2022, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Items 1, 2, and 3.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner Ho.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Fisher, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Pham, Garcia,
  Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Mojarro, Dorado

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no Discussion Items.

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 4:  ZONING TEXT AMENDMENT AMD-24-02,  ZONING MAP
  AMENDMENT AMD-25-01, GENERAL PLAN MAP AMENDMENT
  AMD-25-02 (7:02 P.M.)
  • Citywide
  • Applicant: City of Alhambra
  • This is a City-initiated application for Zoning Text Amendment
  AMD-24-02 amending and adding various sections of the
  Alhambra Municipal Code on zoning to address new State
  legislation, eliminate inconsistencies, clarify ambiguous
  provisions, correct typographical and formatting errors, and
  modify use allowances. Zoning Map Amendment AMD-25-01 and
  General Plan Map Amendment AMD-25-02 will amend the City of
  Alhambra Official Zoning Map and General Plan Land Use Map to
  address  inconsistencies,  mapping  errors,  and  prior
  recommendations of the Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 25-02
  recommending that the City Council adopt Zoning Text
  Amendment AMD-24-02, an ordinance amending and adding
  various sections of the Alhambra Municipal Code on Zoning, and
  also adopt Zoning Map Amendment AMD-25-01 and General
  Plan Map Amendment AMD-25-02, an amendment of the City of
  Alhambra Official Zoning Map and General Plan Land Use Map,
  and finding Zoning Text Amendment AMD-24-02, Zoning Map
  Amendment AMD-25-01, and General Plan Map Amendment
  AMD-25-02 to be exempt from review under the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Sections
  15060(c)(2) and 15061(b)(3) of Title 14 of the California Code of
  2
  03/17/2025
   Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review projects that will
  not result in a direct or reasonably foreseeable indirect physical
  change in the environment and that have no possibility of causing
  a significant effect on the environment, respectively.
  •  Principal Planner Maia McCurley provided the Staff
  presentation.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Lewis McCammon

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Items 24 and 25 of the Zoning Text Amendment
  with respect to number 24 adding words, “for a use,” into the statutory
  language between the words “permit” and “that,” and with respect to
  number 25, eliminating any incidences of “including any amendments
  or successor statutes thereto,” throughout the Zoning Code.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner
  Dorado.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Dorado, Fisher, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Pham,
  Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Mojarro

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Item 35 of the Zoning Text Amendment striking
  definition number 6, “High Quality Transit Corridor,” and number 10,
  “Major Transit Stop,” from the Zoning Code.
  •  Moved by Vice President Garcia, Seconded by Commissioner
  Grijalva.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Dorado, Fisher, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Pham,
  Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Mojarro

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 4, with the amendments as specified
  and the additional proposed revision to the ADU ordinance.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Vice President
  Garcia.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Dorado, Fisher, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Pham,
  Garcia, Olson
  3
  03/17/2025
   Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Mojarro

G.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  Raudell Alviso addressed the Commission regarding second hand smoke and
  smoke free housing. (8:19 P.M.)

H.  COMMENTS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSION AND CONFERENCE/MEETING
  REPORTS:

  •  Commissioner Pham announced that it is her last meeting. She thanked staff
  and the Commissioners for all of their hard work. (8:24 P.M.)

  •  Vice President Garcia thanked staff for the streamlined staff report. (8:24 P.M.)

  •  President Olson invited everyone to the Alhambra Historical Society meeting
  that will feature Women’s history. (8:25 P.M.)

I.  COMMENTS FROM STAFF:

  •  Deputy Director Reynoso provided information on the Multi-family Design
  Guidelines that will go before City Council for a kick-off presentation, and back to
  the Planning Commission in the fall. She added the Historic Preservation
  Ordinance first draft is in process and will come to the Planning Commission in
  July, after adoption by the Historic Preservation Commission. (8:25 P.M.)

J.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:27 P.M. to Monday,
  April 7, 2025, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Chris Olson
  President
